# Andersen Group Appoints Daniel DePaoli and Peter Coscia to Board of Directors


October 13, 2026 11:02am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_90be8b0c332be2b76584da5a9650ccc1/andersen/news/2026-10-13_Andersen_Group_Appoints_Daniel_DePaoli_and_Peter_263.pdf)


*Senior Executives Bring Deep Operational Expertise to Complement Board’s Capital Markets and Corporate Governance Experience*


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Andersen Group Inc. (NYSE: ANDG) today announced the appointment of Daniel DePaoli and Peter Coscia, two longtime senior executives, to its Board of Directors, strengthening the Board's operational expertise as the Company continues to execute its global growth strategy.


The appointments bring decades of hands-on leadership and deep institutional knowledge to a Board whose outside directors contribute capital markets, corporate governance and business experience. Their addition further aligns Board oversight with Andersen's strategic priorities, including organic growth, acquisitions and the expansion of its global professional services platform.


"Dan and Peter have been instrumental in building Andersen into the organization it is today," said Mark L. Vorsatz, Chairman and CEO of Andersen Group Inc. "Their deep operational experience and understanding of our business complement the considerable financial, governance and strategic expertise of our outside directors. As we accelerate our global expansion, their perspectives will be invaluable in helping the Board better understand our growth strategy and long-term value creation."


DePaoli oversees a significant portion of the firm's operations. He has held senior leadership positions at Andersen since 2002 and previously served as a tax partner at Arthur Andersen. DePaoli has more than 30 years of professional services experience and holds degrees from Hamilton College and the University of Hartford.


Coscia oversees operations across the eastern United States and Caribbean. He has held numerous leadership positions at Andersen since 2002, including Managing Director of its Metro New York office. With more than 35 years of experience, Coscia previously held positions at Arthur Andersen and Deloitte. He holds degrees from Pace University and Brooklyn Law School.


The appointments underscore Andersen's commitment to a Board that combines independent oversight with direct operational knowledge as the Company scales its business and pursues long-term growth opportunities.


**About Andersen**


Andersen is a leading provider of independent tax, valuation and financial advisory services to individuals, family offices, businesses and alternative investment funds in the United States. Andersen’s differentiated approach to client service is rooted in core values that emphasize stewardship, transparency and the seamless delivery of independent, high-quality service. Worldwide, Andersen’s presence spans more than 180 countries through its global platform of member and collaborating firms delivering tax, legal, valuation and consulting services across more than 1,000 locations with over 3,000 partners and 50,000 professionals.
